environment.fontMeasurement: Node deterministic fallback; no browser font or paint measurement

limitations: Node measures actual source reads, contract validation and Scene construction. It does not paint Canvas/SVG or measure browser frames, input latency, long tasks or SVG DOM nodes.
Source indexing occurs once and is reported separately. Cold samples are fresh reads/scenes from the prepared source, not full independent browser-controller first frames.
Full input and source index remain resident. These memory totals are not the runtime-only 128 MiB metric.
No renderer cache is used in this Node pipeline. Browser hot-cache and scheduler metrics require the browser harness.
